watch.name: GigSky
watch.what: eSIM travel data provider that powers a prepaid international data perk on a rival premium card.
watch.why_fit: Low-cost, high-use travel benefit that fills the gap if US Bank's Altitude Connect perk ends, and could be pitched to premium card teams.

history.note: US Bank confirmed its Altitude Connect GigSky benefit (15 days / 5GB eSIM data) may end 11/30/26, which could open a travel data benefit gap.
